metadataReview.coordinateBasis: ONI combat narrative, official NHHC 2019 edition: printed p. 51 (PDF p. 65), visually inspected track chart. Its coordinate arrow points to the DESDIV 45 track at 0143: 5°16′20″ S, 153°44′30″ E. Arithmetic conversion to longitude first gives [153.741667,-5.272222]. This is an American approach position at 0143, not the first radar contact at 0141 or a surveyed battle center. The historical chart’s datum and navigation error are unspecified; no modern positional accuracy is claimed.

note:
The surface action involved five destroyers per side. Ship-loss animation counts three Japanese destroyers sunk and no American ship losses. Uzuki was damaged but escaped; its separate damage entry does not add a fourth animated loss. NHHC reports 647 Japanese sailors and naval aviation personnel lost without a category breakdown here; no human death or casualty quantity is inferred. The industrial-warship models are generic silhouettes, not reconstructions of the individual destroyers. Ship counts do not establish crew numbers, tonnage or fighting power.
